description: This file defines the tlInventory class, which manages inventory items such as servers or machines within a test project in the TestLink system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving inventory data from a database, as well as validation and auditing features.

classes.name: tlInventory
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the inventory of servers/machines in a test project, including CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new tlInventory object with the given test project ID and optional database handler.

methods.name: initInventoryData
methods.description: Initializes inventory data from input array.

methods.name: getCurrentData
methods.description: Returns the current inventory data as an object.

methods.name: readDB
methods.description: Reads inventory data from the database based on given IDs and options.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Creates or updates an inventory record in the database.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the inventory record from the database.

methods.name: deleteInventory
methods.description: Deletes an inventory item by ID, with audit logging.

methods.name: setInventory
methods.description: Creates or updates inventory data based on provided input.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all inventory data for the current test project.

methods.name: checkInventoryData
methods.description: Validates inventory data, ensuring name and IP address uniqueness.

methods.name: getAuditData
methods.description: Retrieves audit information related to the inventory item for logging.
